options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option 'When market price falls below Average Total Cost (P < ATC)'. Confuses the direct economic relationship with its inverse counterpart.

options.text: When total revenue equals total fixed costs
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option 'When total revenue equals total fixed costs'. Confuses related economic terms or textbook categories.

options.text: When market price falls below the minimum Average Variable Cost (P < AVC)
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. States short-run shutdown condition P < AVC.

options.text: When marginal cost equals zero
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option 'When marginal cost equals zero'. Applies an incorrect formula or misplaces numerator and denominator.

detailedSolution:
1. The short-run shutdown condition is P < AVC. If price cannot even cover variable operating costs (fuel, wages, raw materials), the firm minimizes losses by producing zero output rather than incurring operating losses on top of fixed costs.
Hence Option C is correct.
